info.name: Infoblox WAPI (Web API) DHCP DNS Records API

params.name: _return_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use _return_fields+ to add fields to the default set.

params.name: _max_results
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. The default is 1000. Use a negative value to return all results.

params.name: _paging
params.description: Set to 1 to enable result paging. When enabled, a next_page_id is returned if more results are available.

params.name: _page_id
params.description: The page identifier returned from a previous paged request. Used to retrieve the next page of results.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by the fully qualified domain name of the A record.

params.name: ipv4addr
params.description: Filter by the IPv4 address of the A record.

params.name: view
params.description: Filter by the DNS view name.

params.name: zone
params.description: Filter by the DNS zone name.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of DNS A records from the Infoblox appliance. Supports filtering by name, IP address, view, zone, and other fields. Use the _return_fields parameter to specify which fields to include in the response. Results can be paginated using _max_results and _paging parameters.

info.name: Infoblox Create a DNS A record

items.docs: Creates a new DNS A record with the specified name and IPv4 address. The record is created in the specified DNS view, or the default view if none is specified. Returns the object reference of the newly created record.

info.name: Infoblox Get a DNS A record

params.name: ref
params.description: The object reference string that uniquely identifies the WAPI object.

params.name: _return_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Use _return_fields+ to add fields to the default set.

items.docs: Retrieves a specific DNS A record by its object reference. Use the _return_fields parameter to specify which fields to include in the response.

info.name: Infoblox Update a DNS A record

params.name: ref
params.description: The object reference string that uniquely identifies the WAPI object.

items.docs: Updates an existing DNS A record identified by its object reference. Only the fields included in the request body are modified. Returns the object reference of the updated record.

info.name: Infoblox Delete a DNS A record

params.name: ref
params.description: The object reference string that uniquely identifies the WAPI object.

items.docs: Deletes a DNS A record identified by its object reference. Returns the object reference of the deleted record.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of DNS host records. A host record contains the DNS and DHCP data for a host, including one or more IP addresses. Supports filtering by name, view, and zone.

info.name: Infoblox Create a DNS host record

items.docs: Creates a new DNS host record with the specified name and IP addresses. A host record can contain multiple IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and automatically creates the corresponding A and AAAA records.
